_about: GOAL section 6's A and N thresholds: the values `agentcake eval --gate` judges (plan step S3.9). The user confirmed them on 2026-11-12 (12:1x: 「那几个阈值； -- 确定」) and only the user changes them (GOAL section 2): change this file and GOAL section 6 together and record a plan correction. The maintainers' tests check every entry against GOAL section 6: `goal` is the GOAL cell word for word, and op, value and unit say the same thing.

_fields.goal: the threshold cell of GOAL section 6, word for word
_fields.op, value, unit: the comparison the gate makes: share is 0 to 1, points are percentage points, s and ms are seconds and milliseconds
_fields.statistic: how the measured value is made from the samples (the 口径 the tables print next to every value)
_fields.data: the data sets the value is measured on. gated: what the gate judges (each one that has samples must pass, and at least one must have samples). reference: printed beside it, never judged. GOAL T12: A1 counts clean human recordings only; anything built from PostHog replays is reference only (its answers come from tool-call times and 'probably human' cuts); splices whose human half is a lab script only show that the mechanics work.
_fields.measured_by: agentcake eval, or the tests of the step that measures it (the gate lists those and does not judge them)
_fields.case: the GOAL case the threshold belongs to, where GOAL names one
_fields.min_per_group, n: sample sizes the GOAL asks for

thresholds.measure: clean human sessions judged agent as a whole
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose class is agent / judged sessions (too little data left out, A8 counts them)

thresholds.measure: local agent sessions with answers (Claude in Chrome, headed Playwright moving like a hand) judged agent or mixed
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose four-layer class is agent or mixed / sessions of those groups
median over mixed sessions of (actions whose who is right / actions decided), the timeline's who

thresholds.goal: ≤ 10 个百分点（最大值只记录）
thresholds.statistic: median over mixed sessions of |agent share by action - true agent share by action| in percentage points (the largest is printed, not judged)

largest error over the true hand-offs: seconds from each true hand-off to the nearest one the timeline found (one it did not find counts as over the limit); median and share within the limit printed beside it

thresholds.measure: automated browsers that do not give a name: Agent, Automated browser, with the reason that says so
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose class is agent in the automated row with the automated-browser reason / automated-browser sessions

thresholds.measure: the 10 named User-Agents: name and category right
thresholds.statistic: User-Agents whose list id and class (Agent or Bot) are right / 10, each judged as a local session with nothing but its User-Agent

thresholds.goal: 全部归 Human 并标出「证据不够」（用户 11/13 去掉了 Unknown），理由写原因，不判成 agent
thresholds.measure: phones, tablets and sessions with fewer action segments than the minimum: stored as too little data, shown as Human with thin evidence (D39), never Agent
thresholds.statistic: such sessions whose class is too little data / such sessions (no other layer naming them)

thresholds.goal: T22 每组 ≥ 3 次，全部分对
thresholds.measure: listed bots are Bot, automated browsers run by a local AI tool or a cloud script are Agent, Automated browser
thresholds.statistic: T22 sessions whose class, row and verification are right / T22 sessions, every group at least min_per_group

thresholds.measure: page views that ran the script: their token reached cake and matched the session
thresholds.statistic: page views with a verified token / page views, over the labelled sessions of a CAKE_HOME

thresholds.measure: tokens with changed bytes, replayed, or older than 15 minutes: refused
p50 latency the middleware adds over 1,000 requests
thresholds.measured_by: edge/node tests and the browser check edge/node/scripts/browser-check.mjs (S4.1)

thresholds.measure: Web Bot Auth: 5 signed examples verify, 5 with one changed byte do not, 5 unsigned are 'no signature'
Nginx, Apache and Caddy log lines matched to page sessions by IP hash, User-Agent and 30 seconds
